text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun is even more enthusiastic than usual, determined to earn her place in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now a "twinkly" racer that others are desperate to compete against, she steels herself for the race.
